objective: Protect foliage physical-data texel fidelity before native-4K grading by closing an importer-precision gap in generated dry-leaf normal and smoothness maps, without awarding visual points before real Unity-rendered evidence exists.

investigation.selectedIssue: QualityBlockPbrUpgrade generates PBR_LeafDark and PBR_LeafMid normal plus metallic/smoothness textures through the generic generated-PBR path, whose importer policy is CompressedHQ. Existing foliage physicality QA validates shader/material physics, transmission, dielectric response and morphology but did not independently require lossless import precision for the generated leaf normal direction and smoothness alpha signals.
investigation.risk: Block compression can quantize the weak tangent-space micro-normal and dry-leaf smoothness signals before grazing-light or subpixel-temporal review. A scene could therefore satisfy the foliage material contract while the imported physical-data texture no longer preserves the authored signal closely enough for a credible 4K benchmark.
investigation.scopeDecision: Gate only the four high-value physical-data textures: LeafDark/LeafMid normal maps and metallic-smoothness maps. Do not force leaf albedo lossless: NewTown/FoliageTransmission derives lamina silhouette analytically rather than from albedo alpha, so the lower-frequency colour map does not justify the same memory cost. Preserve physical-data precision where it directly affects normals, roughness and temporal grazing response.

changes.summary: Added a machine-readable zero-point contract for the four generated foliage physical-data textures. Canonical state is Uncompressed, Crunch off, no Standalone override, 1024x1024, mipmapped, Repeat, Trilinear, anisotropy >=8 and linear; normals remain NormalMap and smoothness masks preserve input alpha. The contract records dry dielectric leaf physics, formal-evidence requirements, failure injections and zero automatic Visual Fidelity points.

Added InitializeOnLoad/import/save preparation plus formal pre-cull read-only validation. Preparation may reassert canonical importer state after generated textures are created or reimported; QA4K_, QATemporal_ and QAPreparedTemporal_ targets never repair in-flight and fail closed on compression, Crunch, platform override, size, mip, filter, anisotropy, colour-space, texture-type or alpha drift.

physicalReasoning.manufactureAndStructure: Leaf macro morphology, lamina thickness/curvature, twig attachment and woody continuity remain owned by the existing foliage morphology/physicality systems; this run changes only texture-signal preservation and does not invent new plant geometry.
physicalReasoning.normalSignal: Generated leaf micro-normal uses the existing analytic height/noise/vein construction and is consumed by NewTown/FoliageTransmission with bounded normal scale. The importer must preserve tangent-space direction rather than introduce block-scale facets.
physicalReasoning.materialResponse: Living dry leaves remain non-metallic dielectric material with custom F0 around 0.03, bounded smoothness, GGX direct specular and Schlick Fresnel. No baked or painted highlight is permitted.
physicalReasoning.weathering: No new arbitrary weathering was added; existing cause-based foliage/vegetation context remains authoritative.

formalEvidenceBehavior.preparation: Generated target imports and scene-save preparation may restore canonical import state before evidence capture.
formalEvidenceBehavior.formalPreCull: Read-only and fail-closed for QA4K_*, QATemporal_* and QAPreparedTemporal_* render targets; no importer repair is allowed during formal evidence capture.
futureRequiredVisualEvidence: fresh 3840x2160 frontal benchmark with foliage visible
fresh 3840x2160 oblique benchmark with foliage visible
temporal subpixel/grazing sequence demonstrating stable mips and absence of leaf shimmer
formalEvidenceBehavior.visualScoring: No automatic points. Vegetation, texture and temporal categories must still be scored only from actual Unity-rendered pixels.

failureInjection: Set any protected leaf normal or smoothness texture to CompressedHQ
Change filter mode to Bilinear or Point
Enable sRGB on a physical-data texture
Change a leaf normal away from NormalMap texture type
Discard or ignore source alpha on a leaf smoothness texture
